question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Harrasment**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Harassment**".
 
• The word means the act of persistently annoying or attacking someone. (किसी को लगातार परेशान करने या हमला करने की क्रिया)
 
• It is a **noun **and can be used in **sentences** like "*She faced harassment at her workplace*" or "*The harassment needs to stop immediately*".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Receipt**", is spelled correctly and means a written or printed statement confirming that something has been paid for or received. (रसीद)
 
• "**Technically**", is spelled correctly and means in a way that relates to the practical application of scientific and industrial knowledge. (तकनीकी तौर पर)
 
• "**Vaccinate**", is spelled correctly and means to administer a vaccine to protect against a disease. (टीकाकरण करें)
